l1_words.meaning: folder (a cover for keeping papers together)

pattern_explanation: These look-alike forms share an old source, but their meanings drifted apart over time. Matching by appearance alone leads to mistakes, so the student must check the meaning.
false_friend_warning: Warning: four of these look-alike forms are false friends. They resemble the English words carpet, library, embarrassed, and actually, but their meanings are different. Match by meaning, not by appearance.
